result:
The round 258 check fails because of one Medium bug in the perf test harness. I found no regression in the app itself.

This second attempt picked up from attempt 1's checkpoint, which had already run every row. I did not re-run rows. On the current commit (`d732d26`, with no uncommitted changes) I re-checked the bug evidence: it still stands, and `/studio-lab` loads (HTTP 200).

**Bug for B: C-R258-01 (Medium).** The perf tests (`npm run test:perf`) are out of date with the app:
- **Play button:** `perf/lib/page.ts` lines 63–76 wait for the Play button to change its label to "Pause". Since round 256 (SABA-B-9 stage 1) it no longer does; `data-playing` holds the state now.
- **Clip title:** `perf/studio-lab-interactions.perf.spec.ts` line 110 looks for the title "drag = time selection · click = playhead". The app now says "… click = insert marker" (`strings.ts` line 694, rounds 252–253).
- **Result:** two of the three perf specs (PERF-1a and PERF-1b-i) abort on every pass, and 154 budget checks fail with no measurements. So the fader, drag and playback speed limits are not measured on the published code. Only the resources spec passes.
- **Fix:** it belongs in `perf/lib/page.ts` and the interactions spec. A note in `perf/budgets*.json` also mentions "Pause".

**Browser results** (real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720; one row also at 390 px wide):
- 114 rows passed: transport, markers, shortcut sheet, overview, tempo and grid, faders and focus, cursors, MP3 and legacy export, the store pages, and `npm run test:e2e:smoke`.
- **Premium sign-in is not bypassed.** A fresh browser with no login opens the `/studio-lab` demo. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no token and 500 with a fake one, never 200.
- 5 rows are BLOCKED because the backend is unavailable in the cloud: SRW-21, R80 recordings borders, `/account` and ChatInput, the backend half of the legacy-ownership check, and the scroll-lock dialogs that need sign-in.
- 5 rows are left to the root gate, as the rules require.

`c-round-258-result.json` (and its attempt-1 copy) is empty. If root builds it from my final message, that may be why attempt 1 was judged as stopped early. I own only `c-round-258.md`, `c-round-258.json` and the `c-round-258/` folder, so I did not write to it. Its contents are below.

```json
{"round":258,"taskStatus":"FAIL","bugs":[{"id":"C-R258-01","severity":"medium"}],"browserVerified":true,"realVerified":true,"passed":114,"blocked":5,"gate":5}
```
